question: For each IPv4 subnet name, show the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of routes per subnet, considering only subnets whose ID is in ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'). Do not return any rounded answers.

       MAX(rc.route_count) - MIN(rc.route_count) AS route_range,
       VARIANCE(rc.route_count) AS route_variance,

       MAX(rc.cnt) - MIN(rc.cnt) AS range,
       VARIANCE(rc.cnt) AS variance,
       STDDEV(rc.cnt) AS stddev
FROM subnets s
JOIN (
  SELECT subnet_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM subnetroutes
  GROUP BY subnet_id
) rc ON rc.subnet_id = s.id
WHERE s.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')
  AND s.ip_version = 4
GROUP BY s.name;
